# Fleet Failure Atlas

> An executable field guide to autonomous coding-agent failures.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/korovin-aa97/fleet-failure-atlas
Searchable site: https://korovin-aa97.github.io/fleet-failure-atlas/
Machine index: https://korovin-aa97.github.io/fleet-failure-atlas/atlas.json
License: MIT

## Core documents

- README.md: product overview and quickstart
- docs/PATTERN_SCHEMA.md: required entry and fixture contract
- docs/SAFETY_AND_PROVENANCE.md: execution and evidence boundaries
- CONTRIBUTING.md: contribution workflow
- regression-review-checklist.md: human review checklist
- skills/regression-review/SKILL.md: agent-consumable review skill

## Commands

- python3 atlas.py check
- python3 atlas.py run
- python3 atlas.py run FFA-001 --mode detect

FFA-001 through FFA-004 are hypothetical clean-room reproductions. FFA-005 and
FFA-006 are externally reported and cite public primary sources while keeping
their fixtures synthetic. Read each provenance section before inferring a real
event.
